title: OpenShift Energy Cost
description: Dollar cost of running the ocp cluster, per node / component / GPU, over the dashboard time range. Rates: Dominion Energy VA Schedule 1 (zip 23236), marginal >800 kWh tier including all per-kWh riders, filings effective 2026-07-01 - summer (Jun-Sep) 14.834 c/kWh = distribution 2.3596 + generation 4.6243 + transmission 0.970 + riders 6.8805 (Fuel A 3.7648, T1 1.1789, DIST 0.7685, GEN 0.5729, SNA 0.3475, C4A 0.1336, E 0.0625, SMR 0.0287, C1A 0.0231, RGGI 0); winter (Oct-May) 12.907 c/kWh with generation 2.6965. Season picked automatically per sample via month(). Node watts are MODELED (idle + (max-idle) x CPU busy; tune w_* variables); GPU watts/energy are MEASURED via DCGM. TrueNAS chassis and network gear are out of scope (see Lab Power / Power Consumption).

panels.title: Cluster draw now
panels.description: Modeled wall watts of all 5 OCP nodes (per-node linear idle-to-max CPU model, constants in dashboard variables) plus measured GPU watts (DCGM). casval reads 0 when scaled down.

targets.expr: (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="ocp.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_ocp_max - $w_ocp_idle) + $w_ocp_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="hpg5.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_hpg5_max - $w_hpg5_idle) + $w_hpg5_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="p330.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_p330_max - $w_p330_idle) + $w_p330_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="casval.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_casval_max - $w_casval_idle) + $w_casval_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="truenas-w1.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_tnw1_max - $w_tnw1_idle) + $w_tnw1_idle) or vector(0)) + (sum(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE) or vector(0))

panels.title: Energy - selected range
panels.description: Cluster kWh over the dashboard time range (average modeled watts x hours).

targets.expr: avg_over_time(((((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="ocp.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_ocp_max - $w_ocp_idle) + $w_ocp_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="hpg5.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_hpg5_max - $w_hpg5_idle) + $w_hpg5_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="p330.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_p330_max - $w_p330_idle) + $w_p330_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="casval.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_casval_max - $w_casval_idle) + $w_casval_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="truenas-w1.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_tnw1_max - $w_tnw1_idle) + $w_tnw1_idle) or vector(0)) + (sum(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE) or vector(0)))[$__range:5m]) * $__range_s / 3600 / 1000

panels.title: Cost - selected range
panels.description: Energy over the dashboard range priced at the Dominion VA Schedule 1 marginal rate (>800 kWh tier, all riders). Seasonal rate picked by month(): Jun-Sep = $rate_summer, Oct-May = $rate_winter.

targets.expr: (avg_over_time(((((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="ocp.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_ocp_max - $w_ocp_idle) + $w_ocp_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="hpg5.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_hpg5_max - $w_hpg5_idle) + $w_hpg5_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="p330.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_p330_max - $w_p330_idle) + $w_p330_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="casval.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_casval_max - $w_casval_idle) + $w_casval_idle) or vector(0)) + (((1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="truenas-w1.igou.systems",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * ($w_tnw1_max - $w_tnw1_idle) + $w_tnw1_idle) or vector(0)) + (sum(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE) or vector(0)))[$__range:5m]) * $__range_s / 3600 / 1000) * ($rate_winter + ($rate_summer - $rate_winter) * ((scalar(month()) >= bool 6) * (scalar(month()) <= bool 9)))

panels.title: Projected monthly cost
panels.description: Average draw over the selected range extrapolated to 30.44 days (730.5 h) at the seasonal Dominion rate.

panels.title: Power by node - modeled + GPUs measured
panels.description: Per-node linear model: idle watts + (max-idle) x CPU busy fraction. Tune the w_* dashboard variables to calibrate. GPUs are actual DCGM watts, additive to casval's CPU line. Gaps = node powered off.

panels.title: Cost by node - selected range
panels.description: Dollar cost of each node over the dashboard time range. Node CPU side is modeled; the GPU bar is measured energy (DCGM mJ counter).

panels.title: GPU cost by card & workload - selected range (measured)
panels.description: Measured GPU energy (DCGM_FI_DEV_TOTAL_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION) split per GPU and per consuming namespace, priced at the seasonal Dominion rate. kWh = $ / rate.

panels.title: Cost by component (top 10 namespaces) - selected range
panels.description: Modeled node energy (GPU excluded - see GPU panel) allocated to namespaces by their share of cluster CPU-seconds over the range. Includes each namespace's share of idle overhead.
